experiments.scope: Reduced event on the selected Orchard Poseidon target at its own round count: the first 14 bits of the big-endian reading of the 32-byte digest agree for two distinct canonical messages. One birthday search per organizer trial over fresh inputs from the trial seed. No full collision is expected or claimed.
experiments.hypothesis: A search of at most 1200 fresh inputs returns a pair whose digests agree on those 14 bits in every trial, as a random 14-bit function would (about 160 inputs on average). Checks the digest of the selected target at one reduced width; it says nothing about the full-width map, the cost or the success probability.
